# TikTok Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that reads your TikTok account through the TikTok API v2: your profile and your video list with view, like and comment counts. Read-only by design — no posting command is shipped, and posting must never be claimed to work. Honest note: TikTok requires app review and approval before API access works at all, so expect an approval step first. No secrets in the repo — credentials stay in Muse's secure vault.
